description: NEW. One ordinary en catalog plus two rawFiles that are byte-for-byte twins except for the encoding of their NAME: 'messages' (ASCII) and '文字' (non-ASCII). CJK was chosen deliberately over a Latin accent because CJK ideographs have no canonical decomposition, so the name cannot differ between an NFC-writing build machine and an NFD-normalizing filesystem. Serves the clause's 'portable ASCII identifiers, and non-ASCII identifiers classified as informational' requirement. Not loadOnly: verified that both the filesystem and discovery loads pick up only 'en' and skip the two non-tag names silently, so Strings construction succeeds.
